reviews.title: Risk vs Reward Purchase
reviews.comment: 3 Stars at most. I knew buying a refurbished card was risky, unfortunately since the first day it has been crashing in multiple games. I've had to move the slider all the way down to -160ish Mhz on GPUTweak 2 for it to perform somewhat stable in games. It's definitely the card as I have clean installed any and all software that could be related. Unfortunately to late to return now. But when it runs without issues, performance is great.
